title: Billboard and Planet Fitness Celebrate the Power of Music, Movement & Motivation in New Partnership
summary: Regional listening trends become the soundtrack for movement in a new Billboard and Planet Fitness editorial series celebrating music, motivation and community
contentText:
The right song can change the energy of a workout, a commute, or an everyday routine. Billboard and Planet Fitness have partnered for a new editorial series of custom  Movement Mixes  celebrating the music that inspires movement while reflecting the sounds and culture of communities across the county.
Built on the idea that motivation looks different for everyone, the series explores the relationship between music and movement through a local lens.  Rather than taking a one-size-fits-all approach, each playlist is inspired by the artists and songs resonating within communities across the country, recognizing that what keeps someone moving in Chicago may be different (or maybe the same?) from what motivates someone in Miami.

The partnership will feature eight curated playlists, each inspired by the sounds and energy of the regions they represent. Using Billboard Charts, editorial expertise and backed by Luminate data, the  Movement Mixes  transform regional listening trends into culturally relevant soundtracks that meet listeners where they are while reinforcing Planet Fitness’ commitment to creating a welcoming, Judgement Free environment where everyone feels like they belong and they can reach their fitness goals.

“At Planet Fitness, we know nothing gets you through a workout better than a great playlist,” said Trupti Patil, Vice President of National Media & CRM at Planet Fitness. “By partnering with Billboard, an iconic leader in the music industry, we’re bringing together the power of fitness and music to motivate people wherever they are, and however they choose to move.”

Whether you’re heading to the gym, getting ready for a concert, or simply looking for a boost of motivation throughout the day, these Movement Mixes celebrate the power of music to motivate every wellness journey – bringing together local culture, community and movement in a way that’s uniquely personal. Start today with Midwest Momentum and press play.
